description: This file defines the VirtualBucketsRingProvider class, which manages a consistent hashing ring with virtual buckets for load distribution among silos in Orleans. It handles server membership, range calculations, and notifications for range changes, implementing interfaces for ring management and silo status listening.

classes.name: VirtualBucketsRingProvider
classes.description: Manages a consistent hashing ring with virtual buckets, handling server membership, range calculations, and range change notifications within Orleans.

methods.name: GetRingSize
methods.description: Returns the number of distinct silos in the ring.

methods.name: SubscribeToRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to range change events.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from range change events.

methods.name: NotifyLocalRangeSubscribers
methods.description: Notifies all subscribers about a range change.

methods.name: AddServer
methods.description: Adds a silo to the ring and updates ranges.

methods.name: RemoveServer
methods.description: Removes a silo from the ring and updates ranges.

methods.name: UpdateRange
methods.description: Recalculates the ring range based on current server membership.

methods.name: CalculateRange
methods.description: Calculates the range responsibilities for a given silo based on the sorted list of buckets.

methods.name: GetRanges
methods.description: Returns the list of silos and their ranges for debugging.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles silo status changes, adding or removing silos accordingly.

methods.name: CalculateTargetSilo
methods.description: Determines which silo owns a given hash key.
